data: La Quête d'Alain Ducasse (The Quest of Alain Ducasse)

Quelle peut être la quête d’Alain Ducasse, le petit garçon des Landes devenu aujourd hui l'un des chefs et mentors les plus reconnus de la cuisine dans le monde ? Celle de l'essence du goût ? D'une gastronomie humaniste engagée et responsable ? Que cherche un homme qui semble avoir déjà tout ? 23 restaurants dans le monde, 18 étoiles Michelin, Alain Ducasse ne cesse de créer des adresses qui plaisent à notre temps, de bâtir des écoles, de pousser les frontières de son métier vers de nouveaux horizons, sa curiosité n’a pas de limite. Il sillonne le monde sans relâche, car pour lui la cuisine est un univers infini. Cet homme public, si secret pourtant, a accepté d’être suivi pendant près de deux ans, nous ouvrant ainsi les portes de son univers, en perpétuelle évolution. (What is the mission undertaken by Alain Ducasse, the boy from Les Landes in south-western France who is known today as one of the world's most famous chefs and cooking mentors. Could it be to find the essence of flavor? Or a humanistic and socially responsible approach to gastronomy? What can a man who seems to have everything still search for? With 23 restaurants around the world and 18 Michelin stars, Ducasse is constantly creating new locations that are in tune with our era, building schools, and pushing the boundaries of his profession toward new horizons. His curiosity is limitless. He tirelessly continues to travel the world, because to him, cuisine is an infinite universe. This man, a public figure who nonetheless guards his privacy closely, accepted to be filmed for almost two years, thus opening the door into his perpetually evolving world.)
